Implementation Model: Single Bank Shared Ledger Network (Single Currency)
Key Considerations: Operates within a single bank's shared ledger to enable internal real-time transfers.

Implementation Model: Multi-Bank (Single Currency, Same Shared Ledger Network)
Key Considerations: Participating banks operate on a shared permissioned ledger with needed agreement on access, rules, and settlement.

Implementation Model: Multi-Bank (Single Currency, Different Shared Ledger Networks)
Key Considerations: Participating banks operate on separate ledgers. Interoperability protocols would be required to coordinate messaging and settlement.

Interoperability protocol required: Depending on the Shared Ledger network and tokenised deposit pair involved.
Key Considerations: FX mechanism is required to support cross-currency transactions, operating within a single shared ledger network or across networks.
